video_title: LIVE: Pelicans vs. Wizards Postgame Interviews 10/16/2026

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on the Pelicans' defensive identity and depth
quotes.excerpt: Our depth is going to be the key for us this year.
quotes.quote: Our depth is going to be the key for us this year. That is going to be one quality that we have to make sure these guys understand. And when we play the right way, we play for each other, we defend the right way, this is going to be the strength of this unit, this team. That is our identity. A defensive identity that is our depth is going to be the key for us.
quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley says the Pelicans are leaning into their depth as a core identity this season. He believes playing for each other and defending the right way will be the strength of this unit.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on the team's willingness to accept challenges
quotes.excerpt: They're willing to take on the challenges. I think it's very big and how connected they are.
quotes.quote: They're willing to take on the challenges. I think it's very big and how connected they are. They've done things together, not just on the court but off the court, that they stay connected, they're pulling for one another. We continue to talk about being able to celebrate your teammate and bringing somebody with you that they've trusted the process of what we're doing in the system-wise for our defense and our offense, and they're really locked in to pulling for one another.
quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley praises the Pelicans for their off-court connection and willingness to pull for one another as they continue to trust the system.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on Zion Williamson's commitment to shooting threes
quotes.excerpt: I love that he shot it. Gosh, I love it. And they look good.
quotes.quote: I love that he shot it. Gosh, I love it. And they look good. I mean, he's putting so much work in, you know, off the court, you know, with sham. I think that every day after practice, he's just done a heck of a job. And I think he continues to trust it. He knows it's it's going to have a chance to go in, and that's why I was, you know, we got to continue to celebrate that for him because he's been putting that work in.
quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley is encouraging Zion Williamson to keep shooting from deep. He says Zion has been putting in the work after practice and needs to continue trusting his shot.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on Jeremiah Fears' growth as a floor general
quotes.excerpt: His command of the floor. We had a meeting this morning and we talked about his ability.
quotes.quote: His command of the floor. We had a meeting this morning and we talked about his ability to command the floor, finding the time when he's going to be aggressive to go score, and then finding the time when he's going to facilitate, and then calming things down when things go back and forth. His ability to do that, that's great growth for that young man.
quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley highlights the growth of Jeremiah Fears as a floor general, specifically noting his improved ability to balance aggressive scoring with facilitating the offense.

quotes.speaker: Jeremiah Fears
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremiah Fears on building team chemistry during preseason
quotes.excerpt: Just figuring each other out. I think that's the most important thing, especially with these preseason games.
quotes.quote: I feel like I played pretty, pretty good. I feel like we're coming along, and just figuring each other out. I think that's the most important thing, especially with these preseason games, figuring each other out and just trying to build that chemistry to get ready for the season and for the first game.
quotes.social_post: Jeremiah Fears says the main focus for the Pelicans during the preseason is figuring each other out and building chemistry ahead of the regular season opener.

quotes.speaker: Jeremiah Fears
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremiah Fears on his thought process as a playmaker
quotes.excerpt: Just trying not to overthink it. I think that's the most important thing, trusting the work.
quotes.quote: Just trying not to overthink it. I think that's the most important thing, trusting the work, being confident in the passes that you make. Like you said, it's a high-risk, high-reward sometimes, but sometimes you got to make those pass and mess up so that you know next time kind of where you can fix it at or how you can be better.
quotes.social_post: Jeremiah Fears on his playmaking approach: Just trying not to overthink it. He says he is trusting his work and staying confident in his passes even when they are high risk.
